build_escnmd_moe_backbone: build an eSCNMDMoeBackbone model with configurable number of experts and MOLE dropout for mixture-of-experts molecular MLIP
merge_mole_model_escnmd: merge the eSCNMDMoeBackbone MOLE layers into a single Linear layer for single-dataset inference optimization
create_dataset_specific_moe_wrapper: create a DatasetSpecificMoEWrapper to route predictions through dataset-specific expert heads using a dataset mapping dictionary
set_mole_coefficients: set MOLE expert mixing coefficients using atomic numbers, batch indices, and CSD mixed embeddings for routing
create_dataset_specific_single_head_wrap: create a DatasetSpecificSingleHeadWrapper to share a single head across multiple datasets with per-dataset output routing
